name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 11.7. Restores the application UI to the original Version 10.7.1 visual design (navbar, 3D logo badge, cards, gradients, signature) verbatim, while retaining every feature consolidated through Version 11.5 underneath it: the V10.7 Multiple Schema Store, the V11.1 additive Stored/Active/Default/Inactive schema state model, the V10.7.1 Secure GitHub Connection Vault (with its anonymous-read fix), the selectable Schema Synchronization Schedule, and operational password management with a non-disclosing Forgot Password reset.
